title: Schedule list has Active and Archived tabs, search and a row menu
custom_preconds:
• You are logged in as a user with "Settings Service" enabled.
  • A maintenance schedule "Highway Tractor PM" with service "PM-A" exists and at least one asset is enrolled on it (asset "Maintenance" tab > "Enroll in Schedule").
  • At least one other active schedule and one archived schedule exist.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings > Maintenance and read the tabs, the columns and the order of the rows.
  2. Click each column header.
  3. In the search above the list, type part of a schedule's name, then a service's name.
  4. Open the row menu of an active schedule.
  5. Open the "Archived" tab and open the row menu of an archived schedule.
  6. Click the archived schedule and try to change its services, triggers and lines.
  7. Go back to the "Active" tab, read the "Assets" cell of "Highway Tractor PM" and click the count.
custom_expected:
• Step 1: There are two tabs, "Active" and "Archived", each with a count. The columns are "Schedule", "Services" and "Assets". By default the rows are sorted by Schedule A-Z.
  • Step 2: Each header sorts the list by that column.
  • Step 3: The search matches schedule names and service names.
  • Step 4: The menu offers "Edit", "Duplicate" and "Archive".
  • Step 5: The menu offers "Restore".
  • Step 6: The schedule is read-only all the way down (services, triggers, lines). There is no delete anywhere.
  • Step 7: The enrolled-asset count is plain read-only text, not a badge, and clicking it opens nothing.
